title: Business Application Consulting - Program Risk & Quality Director
text:
As a Business Application Consulting - Program Risk & Quality Director, you will guide clients through business application transformations within our Advisory practice, bringing program risk and quality considerations into software implementation. This role connects application consulting with security and controls: you will help clients assess their needs, integrate safeguards into cloud-enabled processes, and support adoption across platforms such as Workday, Salesforce, and Microsoft Dynamics 365. You will help organizations manage technology risk while improving how their applications support day-to-day operations.
 
 
As a Director, you will set the direction for this work, cultivate executive client relationships, and identify opportunities to expand services where transformation programs call for integrated controls. You will guide multiple engagements, make decisions informed by program performance and emerging technology, and develop future leaders through coaching and candid feedback. Working across disciplines, you will connect platform architecture, application delivery, and risk perspectives while balancing commercial priorities with professional standards. Your leadership will foster an inclusive environment where people and technology contribute to client outcomes, reflecting PwC’s commitment to integrity and thoughtful service.
 
 
Responsibilities
 
 

* Setting strategic direction for program risk and quality across business application transformations, aligning implementation, security, and controls priorities with client objectives
* Directing risk assessments and quality reviews across application projects, using business data analytics and performance measures to identify delivery gaps and guide corrective action
* Overseeing the design and integration of application access controls, automated monitoring, and compliance processes within cloud solutions such as Workday, Salesforce, and Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Guiding recovery of application security and controls work on large projects, coordinating resources, documentation, and technical consultation to address implementation challenges
* Shaping governance for SaaS security posture management and AI-enabled application integrations, including Model Context Protocol security, through research and the use of digital tools
* Leading teams through software implementation, user training, and ongoing support, coaching emerging leaders and adapting plans based on feedback and operational needs
* Cultivating executive client relationships and developing business opportunities by translating technical risks, transformation progress, and proposed solutions into recommendations for decision-makers
* Upholding professional standards while coordinating project delivery across disciplines, assessing technology performance, and encouraging inclusive collaboration between people and AI-enabled tools

 
What You Must Have
 
 

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 9 years of experience

 
What Sets You Apart
 
 

* Directing security and controls strategy across cloud business application transformations and multiple client engagements
* Leading application security and access control design for Workday, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementations
* Integrating automated controls into business processes and monitoring their performance throughout technology implementations
* Overseeing application security and controls project recovery for large technology implementations
* Shaping SaaS Security Posture Management implementation and governance across client environments
* Guiding Model Context Protocol security and governance for AI-driven solutions
* Coaching project leaders through risk decisions, resource planning, and executive client communication

The salary range for this position is: $155,000 - $410,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law.

PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H-1B-Lottery-Policy.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. At PwC, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.
